errors.text_span: Диаграмата илюстрира промените в обема на вноса и износа на България в периода 2004-2019 г. по отношение на ЕС и други търговски партньори. Всяка линия представлява различна група партньори.
errors.evidence: The description fails to identify that the figure consists of two separate side-by-side plots, one for "Внос" (Imports) and one for "Износ" (Exports). It treats the entire figure as a single chart, leading to a confusing and inaccurate description of the data series.

errors.text_span: Оста X е обозначена с година от 2004 до 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The x-axes are not labeled with the word "година" (year). The two separate plots have distinct labels under their x-axes: "Внос" (Imports) on the left and "Износ" (Exports) on the right.
The chart is in grayscale; it does not contain any red lines.

errors.text_span: се движи от около 70% през 2004 г. до около 30% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The line for EC does not move from 70% to 30%. For Imports, it moves from approximately 58% to 65%. For Exports, it moves from approximately 63% to 67%. The described values are completely incorrect.
The chart is in grayscale; it does not contain any silver lines.

errors.text_span: се движи от около 60% през 2004 г. до около 80% през 2007 г., след което намалява до около 60% през 2009 г. и отново се покачва до около 70% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The values described for the OECD line are incorrect. For Imports, the line starts at ~84% and ends at ~73%. For Exports, it starts at ~92% and ends at ~80%. The described trend and values do not match the data in the figure.

errors.text_span: Линията, която представлява членовете на ЕС
errors.evidence: There is no category in the legend named "членовете на ЕС" (members of the EU). This is a hallucinated category.
The chart is in grayscale; it does not contain any black lines (all lines are shades of gray).
The description incorrectly identifies a second solid line for the non-existent category "членовете на ЕС". There is only one solid line in the chart, which represents "ОИСР".

The description omits three of the five data series shown in the chart: "ОИСР (без членки на ЕС)", "БРИКС" (BRICS), and "Съседни държави" (Neighboring countries). The description for BRICS is misattributed to a solid line.

errors.text_span: линията, която представлява БРИКС, е сива, с плътна линия
errors.evidence: The line for BRICS is a dash-dot line, not a solid ("плътна") line.

errors.text_span: се движи от около 5% през 2004 г.
errors.evidence: The description claims the BRICS line starts at 5% in 2004. In the Imports chart, it starts at approximately 19%. In the Exports chart, it starts at approximately 3%. The value of 5% is inaccurate for both.
